description.en: Full-page canvas workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a project canvas with 23 node types, an Excalidraw whiteboard and a component studio. Data is stored in a local JSON file and the AI reuses the Harness default model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的整页画布工作区：项目画布（23 种组件）、Excalidraw 自由白板与组件工坊。数据存本机 JSON，AI 复用 Harness 默认模型。
